records.name: Ixtal's Impact
records.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

description.value: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

tooltip.value: Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge. Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals {{ pindamage }} physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for {{ stunduration }}s. Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
records.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

description.value: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

tooltip.value: Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with {{ attackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed and dealing {{ abilitydamage }} physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional {{ maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by {{ slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s. Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing {{ spell.skarnerq:abilitydamage }} + {{ spell.skarnerq:maxhppercent*100 }}% max Health physical damage , and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by {{ spell.skarnerq:slowpercent*100 }}% for {{ spell.skarnerq:slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Impale
records.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

description.value: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

tooltip.value: Skarner's tails lash forward, dealing {{ damage }} magic damage and Suppressing the first 3 champions he hits for {{ duration }}s. Those hit are dragged along by Skarner for the duration of this Ability. If Skarner hits at least one champion he gains {{ speedboostamount*100 }}% Move Speed for {{ speedboostduration }} seconds. If Shattered Earth is active, Skarner will cast Upheaval first.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Seismic Bastion
records.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

description.value: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

tooltip.value: Skarner gains {{ initialshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }}s and triggers an earthquake that deals {{ damage }} magic damage and Slows nearby enemies by {{ sloweffect*-100 }}% for {{ slowduration }}s.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

records.name: Threads of Vibration
records.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

description.value: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

lore.value: The ancient, colossal brackern Skarner is revered in Ixtal as one of the founding members of its ruling caste, the Yun Tal. Devoted to keeping his nation safe from the rest of the world, Skarner dwells in a chamber beneath Ixaocan where he can hear the vibrations of the earth and detect potential threats. As more members of the Yun Tal begin questioning Ixtal's self-isolation, Skarner grows increasingly paranoid and will do anything to keep Ixtal and its people safe—no matter the cost.
